source.title: The Spear of Vengeance | An in-depth Kalista Guide!

fields: Her Black Shield can nullify your support's engage and much of your ult's value, and her binding heavily punishes you if you get caught while hopping forward aggressively.
She is excellent at stopping the all-ins you want: her tornado, ult and speed boosts repeatedly break up your engages and separate you from your target.
Her polymorph, slows and shields punish your short-range aggression, and protecting her ADC makes it hard to finish kills with Rend.
Her poke, sustain and CC make long trades uncomfortable, and her bubble is especially dangerous because you rely on constant movement in fights.
His area damage punishes your predictable hopping, and one stun can stop your momentum and let his team burst you.
Her steady poke and slows make your hop-based trading hard, and her ult can catch you before you start stacking spears.
Her plants restrict your movement and punish extended trades, while her long-range poke and area CC make clean engages hard to find.
His long range lets him harass you without giving you trades, and his CC and true-damage ult punish you in extended fights.
He pokes you from outside your trading range, and one misplaced hop into his long-range stun can lead to a devastating punish.
Her healing undoes the value of your short trades and Rend stacks, and her silence zone can stop your support's engage before an all-in completes.
